narrative_hook: Your first task as a future software engineer is to give the computer an instruction and see the result.
title: Hello, World!: Your First Command

narrative_hook: Now that you can send commands, learn to work with the raw materials of programming: the different types of data.
title: The Atoms of Code: Understanding Data

narrative_hook: Great engineers write code not just for computers, but for other humans to understand; learn to leave helpful notes in your code.
title: Digital Footnotes: Leaving Code Comments

narrative_hook: To build dynamic programs, you need to create labeled containers that can hold and manage your data as it changes.
title: Memory Boxes: Storing Information with Variables

narrative_hook: Learn how to protect important information that should never change throughout your program's execution.
title: Set in Stone: Declaring Constants

narrative_hook: Combine all your new skills to build your first complete program: a digital summary of your professional details.
title: Project: Your First Digital Bio
